name: Date With Girlfriend
source:
A very short dating game, go on a date with Girlfriend!

"Date With Girlfriend" is a very short dating game brought to you by Box Team. You can go on a date to a park, get some ice cream, you can even take her to the beach! Do all that, and she'll be the happiest girl in the world!

The MC is nameable, which creates an even more immersive experience!

(This game is a joke plz don't take it seriously.)
